title: Field Listening — Hear the shape of a conversation
examples: Six matched palette studies hold all other controls fixed. Three teal forms hold every control except form fixed. Examples teach authored conventions; they are not measured conversations.
opening_and_close: The creative-work Field from the approved intro, using its actual controls for both expressions.
audio: Only excerpts from the unchanged native Listening renderer, edited at their original rate. No supplementary music or generated soundtrack.
visual_production: Native SVG art. Connected contour morphs, framing, bloom and the audio waveform are film graphics. No separate ghost fields.
